message.reasoning: The user wants the direction the right arm should move to connect the blue Joy-Con to the black module. Looking at the image, the right hand holds the blue module on the right side, while the left hand holds the black module. To connect them, the blue module needs to slide onto the black module, which is to the left of the blue one. So the motion is leftward. The axes shown: yellow is up, red is down, green is right, blue is left. Therefore leftward corresponds to blue. The answer is B.
